The standalone verifier directly checked 3340 parameter cases and 452220 invariant orbit subsets, supporting but not replacing the proof.

originality.rationale: The two inspected primary works establish nonequivariant cycle-power and chordal topology, but not the complete reflection-subgroup PL model. The nearest indexed records treat distinct simplicial complexes or substantially narrower graph classes. The new statement determines an induced path-power model for every reflection-containing subgroup and a mixed-dimensional example; equivalence is not inferred merely from different titles. An unindexed equivalent remains possible.

value.rationale: The all-parameter geometric fixed-point classification concerns intrinsic cyclic powers and all reflection subgroup types, not a selected numerical sample. It proves chordal compression, universal torsion-freeness, and all integral sphere ranks via a finite recurrence. The first small mixed-dimensional instance \(\operatorname{Ind}(P_7^3)\simeq S^0\vee S^1\), revealing topology not inferable from nonequivariant cycle-power homotopy.
